result.title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
result.summary: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to softmax under a unified distillation protocol, and model scala alone does not close these gaps. We show this gap is not intrinsic to kernelization: LARA++, a principled extension of LARA that approximates softmax via importance sampling with adaptive proposal distributions, recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy. We establish that the gap is closable; however, the computational overhead remains substantial, leaving the efficiency wall intact. Code is available at https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026

AI.brief_summary: 论文对 kernelized（线性）注意力做统一评测与蒸馏实验：发现相比 FlashAttention 的效率优势多数难以复现，统一蒸馏协议下与 softmax 存在 2–10 分质量差距，并提出用自适应提案分布重要性采样的 LARA++，最多恢复约 99% 的 softmax 精度，但开销仍高。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「统一蒸馏协议＋近似 softmax 分布」可供核查近似注意力是否会丢失视觉证据细节，且论文给出的训练/推理时间与内存口径可能用于 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 阶段的计算成本核算；但论文不含 latent 推理状态设计，仅为方法线索。
